research_rationale: The complete original section 3(d) includes civil-aircraft accident investigation and section 1 includes that function. EO 11490 section 101 warns of intervening organization changes. The possible Department of Transportation/NTSB transfer is an unresolved earlier-end lead; acquire/read the controlling instrument and distinguish transfer of function from cessation of this order before assigning first ends. No transfer date is established here.
